rationale: The assistant led the customer to the right fix: set the clock and return to manual, with no part and no unsafe steps, and the oven now heats. It never asked about the power cut, though it was close to the cause from the start. When the customer asked 'why did it do that though?', it repeated its previous reply word for word and never explained that the power interruption cleared the clock and locked the oven out. That is a clear repetition failure at the end, though it did not block the fix.
